text: XXXX, As this is the only way I can contact you ( you have no email, phone, or other contact listed ), I must wonder why you avoid answering my question and keep referring to my account not showing a stop payment request on our part. Obviously it is impossible to request a stop payment on our part if the fraud is only spotted AFTER the check has been debited from our account. If I used the words " stop payment '' incorrectly I apologise, but obviously I was referring to the approximately 4 month period from when US Bank froze the forgers account, to when I had the debited amounts credited back to my account. If the CFPB won't deal with this absurd time period, I'll find another regulatory agency that will!
